name: COSCO SHIPPING Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: COSCO Shipping Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2001 as China Shipping Network Technology Co., Ltd. before its rebranding in May 2017, is a Shanghai-headquartered Chinese enterprise operating as a subsidiary of the Shanghai Ship and Shipping Research Institute. The company specializes in the research, development, and sale of advanced software and hardware solutions, primarily focusing on intelligent transportation, maritime logistics informatization, and industrial automation. Its extensive product portfolio includes intelligent traffic control devices such as dynamic message signs and sophisticated automated vehicle violation detection systems for both fixed and mobile enforcement. COSCO Shipping Technology also delivers industrial process automation solutions, comprehensive port electrical systems (including shore power), and related electrical equipment packages. The company offers a wide array of IT services, encompassing strategic planning, project implementation, and ongoing system operation and maintenance. These services provide specialized solutions for the entire maritime logistics chain, covering container and bulk cargo transport, oil and gas shipping, warehousing, terminal operations, as well as ship and crew management. Additionally, it provides integrated security solutions, such as electronic law enforcement forensics, video surveillance, and centralized video network management platforms, catering to public security agencies and various industrial clients. COSCO Shipping Technology's service offerings further extend to engineering project design and construction, network and internet technology development, along with technical consulting, development, and transfer services, and facilitates the import and export of technology products.
